contests.title: Northwestern Local School District — Operating levy renewal

provenance.quote:
Shall a fixed-sum levy renewing an existing levy be imposed by
the Northwestern Local School District, for the purposes of
paying the current operating expenses of the district in the sum of
$456,400 and levy of taxes to be made outside of the ten mill
limitation estimated by the county auditor to average 1.8 mills for
each $1 of taxable value, which amounts to $63 for each
$100,000 of the county auditor’s market value, for a period of 5
years, commencing in 2026, first due in calendar year 2027. The
County Auditor has certified that the amount by which the carry-
over balance in the District’s general operating budget from the
preceding fiscal year exceeds the District’s general fund
expenditures made in the preceding fiscal year is $0, which is 0%
of those expenditures.

Shall Article II, Section 2.09 of the Charter of the City of Norton,
Ohio be changed and amended to read as follows:
SECTION 2.09 COMPENSATION.
The compensation of the Mayor will be set at a salary rate of
$11,250 $15,000 unless submitted to and approved by ballot by
the electors of the Municipality for the next term of office
commencing January 1 of the ensuing year, and such
compensation shall not thereafter be changed with respect to such
period.

Shall Article III, Section 3.08 of the Charter of the City of
Norton, Ohio be changed and amended to read as follows:
SECTION 3.08 COMPENSATION AND REIMBURSEMENTS.
The compensation of the Council members will be set at a salary
rate of $7,500 $10,000 and the President of Council will be set at
a salary rate of $8,500 $11,000, unless submitted to and approved
by ballot by the electors of the Municipality for the next term of
office commencing January 1 of the ensuing year, and such
compensation shall not thereafter be changed with respect to such
period.

contests.title: Norton — Board of Control contract threshold

provenance.quote:
Shall Article V, Section 5.03.B. of the Charter of the City of
Norton, Ohio be changed and amended to read as follows:
SECTION 5.03 BOARD OF CONTROL.
B. APPROVAL OF CONTRACTS.
No contract involving an expenditure in excess of five ten
thousand dollars shall be awarded without the approval of the
Board of Control.

A renewal of a tax for the benefit of the Village of Burbank for
the purpose of current expenses, that the county auditor estimates
will collect $12,951 annually, at a rate not exceeding 4 mills for
each $1 of taxable value, which amounts to $63 for each
$100,000 of the county auditor’s market value, for 5 years,
commencing in 2027, first due in calendar year 2028.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Renews a fixed-sum property levy of $456,400 for current school operating expenses for five years, commencing in 2026 and first due in 2027. The auditor estimates an average rate of 1.8 mills per dollar of taxable value, or $63 per $100,000 of market value. The certified carry-over excess is $0.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Renew the five-year fixed-sum operating levy.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not renew this levy through this question.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Changes the mayor’s charter salary amount from $11,250 to $15,000. It retains the voter-approval rule for compensation changes for the next term beginning January 1 and the restriction on changing compensation for that term.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Adopt the $15,000 salary amount with the stated compensation rules.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not adopt this charter amendment.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Changes council members’ charter salary amount from $7,500 to $10,000 and the council president’s amount from $8,500 to $11,000. It retains the voter-approval rule for changes for the next term beginning January 1 and the restriction on changing pay for that term.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Adopt the proposed council salary amounts and retained compensation rules.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not adopt this charter amendment.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Raises the expenditure threshold above which the Board of Control must approve a contract from $5,000 to $10,000. The rule applies to contracts exceeding the threshold.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not adopt this charter amendment.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Renews a property-tax levy for village current expenses for five years, commencing in 2027 and first due in 2028. The cap is 4 mills per dollar of taxable value; the auditor estimates $12,951 annually and $63 per $100,000 of market value.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not renew this levy through this question.
